title: You Do Not Walk Alone
verse: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
meaning: Moses was old, and he was about to leave his people. They had a hard road and strong enemies ahead. So he told them where courage comes from. Not from being brave, but from God, who goes with them.
heart: God is not waiting for you at the end of the hard thing. He goes into it with you. Maybe today that is a hard call or a room you dread. Before you go in, say it once: you are with me.
holdOn: I do not have to be brave alone. God goes with me.
prayer: God, you know what scares me today. I don't feel strong. Thank you that you go ahead of me and stay beside me. You will not leave me. Walk with me into the hard thing, one step at a time. Amen.
teaser: Courage doesn't start with feeling brave. It starts with who walks beside you.
